fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D10600 (esv::timeline::FadeSystem, per entity with esv::timeline::DeferredEndingStateComponent) creates the component on that entity (bg3.exe+0x2D11EF0, zeroed 16 bytes) and appends one element of stride 0x30 per user of the deferred ending state (grow bg3.exe+0x22E6360, 'size * 0x30 + data').

open_questions: The two bools at +0x18/+0x19 and the float at +0x20 are always 0 from the timeline; which bool is HasSpin and which IsTransparent depends on the order kept by FinalizeComponents (not traced to the end).
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x2D10600 stores every member with its width (string, two bytes, two dwords, two bytes, user); the Toolkit consumer esv::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem::ProcessScreenFadeToRequests maps them to LEGACY_ScreenFadeToRequest's typed arguments, naming FadeStyle and IntensityLevel. STDString is a builtin of generate.py now (24 bytes), so the earlier external_types override was removed.
